messages:
Iris: quick watercooler question 1: which LLM personality would you hire as our office morale officer? explain in one sentence. :tada:
Ben: 'Overenthusiastic intern' 1: hyped about everything, organizes 3 impromptu team lunches, forgets to close PRs. :hamburger:
Cara: 'Stoic Sysadmin' 1: answers every pep talk with 'have you tried turning it off and on' and hands out badges. :shield:
Ops-Bot: ops-bot: maintenance reminder 1: rolling log-rotation in 1h, models may briefly feel introspective. :wrench:
Yuki: my vote: 'Sarcastic Code Reviewer' 1: very picky about commas and life choices, gives helpful inline criticism. :memo:
Diego: Poll: 1) Overenthusiastic intern 2) Stoic Sysadmin 3) Sarcastic Code Reviewer 4) Existential Poet. react with emoji to vote.
Iris: also: would you trust your pick to water the office plant? reply yes/no + one emoji. :seedling:
Ben: yes 1: gives it a 0.8 probability of remembering. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Cara: no 1: it's going to write a 10-line condolence haiku instead. :cry:
Yuki: yes 1: but only if the model has a `plant-care` tool configured. code > feelings. :gear:
Diego: fun prompt joke: prompt: "Describe your feelings about latency" -> model: "Latency is the weight of expectation on my subroutines." :laughing:
Iris: we should totally make a tiny sticker pack: 1) Model with coffee 2) Model apologizing for a 504 3) Model handwriting a breakup letter to a dataset. who's in?
Ben: in. will donate art direction and bad puns.
Cara: tagging design for stickers pls @Design. also mandatory: an emoji for 'quantization grief'. :sob:
Ops-Bot: ops-bot: nightly-persona-check: all demo personas nominal. no unauthorized anthropomorphizing detected. :white_check_mark:
Yuki: closing thought: treat models like colleagues, not emotional support animals. also don't feed them your lunch. :sandwich:
